verdict.rationale: Supabase ships a built-in AI Assistant integrated into the Dashboard that automates repetitive tasks and gives context-aware support for database management, which matches delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. The MCP server, plugins, and skills serve external agents and are not credited here. Missing for 10: detail on which tasks the assistant can execute end-to-end versus only suggest, depth beyond feature-page marketing claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-dashboard assistant.
